title: For My Panda, Who Made My Life Bloom
message: Manpreet, you walked into my life and everything started blooming. This rose is beautiful, but honestly? It’s got nothing on you. Every petal reminds me of something I love about you — the way you say “Rishh” and “Pungdi” in that voice of yours, the way you look at me when you’re pretending to be mad, the way you care about me more than anyone ever has. No one has ever done for me what you do, Putt. You’ve colored my world in ways I didn’t know were possible.

title: My Heart Chooses You, Always
message: Manpreet, if I could go back and choose again — I’d find you even faster. You’re the girl who fights for me, protects me, does everything for me without even being asked. I’ve never had anyone love me the way you do. Today I’m not just saying I love you — I’m telling you that my heart, my time, and my future all have your name written on them. Choosing you is the best thing I’ve ever done, Pungdo.

title: You Make Everything Sweeter, Pungdo
message: You know what, Manpreet? Before you, things were just… okay. But you turned ordinary days into something I actually look forward to. Even when you’re busy irritating me and calling “Rishh! Rishhh!” a hundred times just to get on my nerves — that’s the sweetness I didn’t know my life was missing. You’re my comfort when things get hard and my happiness when things go right. Life just tastes better with you in it.

title: Wrapped in Love, Even from Afar
message: Pathure, I wish I could wrap my arms around you right now and not let go. You’re always there protecting me, caring for me, doing things for me that no one else ever has — and I don’t tell you enough how much that means. On the days I can’t be there, hold this close and think of your Rishh. Every bit of warmth in it is a piece of how much I love you, my cute little Manpreet.

title: A Promise from Your Rishh
message: Manpreet, here’s what I promise you — not just today, but every day that comes after. I promise to protect you the way you protect me. I promise to match even half the love you pour into everything you do for me. I promise to be the reason behind that cute angry face I love so much — and then the reason you smile right after. You are my constant, Pathure, and I’m not going anywhere.

title: Where Your Rishh Finds Home
message: Manpreet, do you know what happens when you hug me? The whole world goes quiet. All the overthinking, all the noise — gone. You look the most beautiful when you’re angry, but you feel the most beautiful when you’re holding me close. Your arms are the one place where my heart feels completely safe. I don’t need a destination when I’m with you, Pungdo, because you already feel like home.

title: A Love Whispered Without Words
message: Manpreet, some things don’t need words — and you prove that every time. The way you care for me says more than a thousand love letters ever could. But when you call me “Rishh” and “Pungdi” in that soft voice and pull me close — that’s my favourite language. One I’ll never get tired of hearing. In that single moment, nothing else matters, Pungdi — just you and me.

title: You Are My Forever Valentine, Manpreet Kaur Bhatti
message: Manpreet Kaur — you’re not just my Valentine today. You’re the girl I choose every single morning and the last thought I hold onto every night. You’re protective, you’re caring, you do everything for me — and I haven’t gotten this kind of love from anyone else in this world. You’re cute, you’re beautiful (especially when you’re angry), and hearing you say “Rishh” is still my favourite sound. Loving you isn’t something I do — it’s who I’ve become. Today, tomorrow, and every day after — it’s you, Pathure. It was always you.
